summary_1line: The gods appeal to Brahma about the destructive Asura brothers, and he creates the irresistible maiden Tilottama to provoke them into conflict.

image_candidates.scene_text: The celestial architect Viswakarman fashions the radiant maiden Tilottama from the brilliance of countless gems before the assembled gods.
Tilottama walks around the divine assembly as Mahadeva sprouts new faces to follow her beauty and Indra gains a thousand eyes.
The devastated earth lies covered in bones and abandoned towns after the Asura brothers slaughter sages and end all sacrifices.
